# 1. Fluad, Vaccine
## Compare DGE between organisms

```{r}
#Import ------
#t-Test
human_fluad_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest =
  readRDS(file = here("tables", "influenza_fluad_human_dge_paired_unpaired_ttest.rds")) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Human")

mouse_fluad_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest =
  readRDS(file = here("tables", "influenza_fluad_mouse_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest.rds")) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Mouse")

#Limma
fluad_human_degs = readRDS(file = here("tables", "influenza_fluad_human_dge_limma_degs.rds")) %>% 
  rename(padj = adj_p_val) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Human",
         test = "Limma",
         paired = "Paired")

fluad_mouse_degs = readRDS(file = here("tables", "influenza_fluad_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds")) %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  rename(padj = adj_p_val) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Mouse",
         timepoint = str_remove(comparison_a, "Time"),
         test = "Limma",
         paired = "Paired") 


#Merge datasets
degs_ttest_limma_mouse_human =
  bind_rows(
    human_fluad_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest,
    mouse_fluad_log2fc_paired_unpaired_ttest,
    fluad_human_degs,
    fluad_mouse_degs
    )

#Summarize  
degs_ttest_limma_mouse_human_summary = degs_ttest_limma_mouse_human %>% 
  group_by(organism, timepoint, test, paired) %>% 
  summarise(
    n_degs = sum(padj <= 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) 

degs_ttest_limma_mouse_human_summary

```


```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=5}
# Plot number of DEGs per test and significance level
degs_ttest_limma_mouse_human_summary_plot_gg <- degs_ttest_limma_mouse_human_summary %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = timepoint,
    y = n_degs,
    fill = test,
    alpha = paired
  )) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8, position = position_dodge2()) +
  
  # Manual colors per test
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "t-Test" = "gray25",
    "Limma" = "#4DBBD5FF"
  )) +
  
  # Alpha: paired = 1, unpaired = 0.5
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c("Paired" = 1, "Unpaired" = 0.2)) +
  
  # Continuous x-axis for numeric timepoints
  scale_x_discrete(
    breaks = sort(unique(degs_ttest_limma_mouse_human_summary$timepoint)),
    expand = c(0.01, 0.01)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  
  theme_vaxgo() +
  labs(
    title = "Total DEGs by test and timepoint",
    subtitle = "Comparison across tests (FDR ≤ 0.05), Fluad vaccine",
    x = "Day",
    y = "Number of DEGs",
    fill = "Test",
    alpha = "Pairing"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~organism, scales = "free_y") +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    axis.line.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "gray75", linetype = 3),
    axis.ticks.y = element_line(color = "gray75")
  )

# Render plot
degs_ttest_limma_mouse_human_summary_plot_gg

degs_ttest_limma_mouse_human_summary_plot_gg %>% 
  ggsave(filename = here("Figures", "influenza_fluad_mouse_human_dge_ttest_limma_summary.png"),
         width = 5,
         height = 5)
```




## Plot demographics
```{r}
#Import datasets
GSE124689_expression_not_normalized_log2_raw_symbol = read_rds(file = here("tables", "influenza_GSE124689_exprs_not_normalized.rds"))
GSE124689_metadata_clean = readRDS(file = here("tables", "influenza_fluad_human_metadata_clean.rds"))
GSE120661_counts_not_normalized_log2_annotations = read_rds(here("tables", "GSE120661_counts_not_normalized_log2_annotations_not_normalized_log2.rds"))
GSE120661_samples_pbmc = read_rds(here("tables", "GSE120661_samples_pbmc.rds"))

#Bind mouse metadata to human data
human_mouse_fluad_metadata = GSE120661_samples_pbmc %>% 
  filter(treatment == "Fluad") %>% 
  select(sample_id = geo_sample, 
         participant_id = subject_id, 
         vaccine = treatment,
         sex,
         strain,
         sample_type = tissue,
         timepoint,
         condition) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Mouse",
         type = "Inactivated",
         adjuvant = "MF59",
         age = 7, #6–8 weeks
         timepoint = as.character(timepoint) %>% as.numeric(.) / 24,
         timepoint = if_else(timepoint < 1 & timepoint != 0,
                             as.character(round(timepoint, 1)),
                             as.character(as.integer(round(timepoint, 0)))),
         race = strain, 
         array = "Agilent-028005 SurePrint G3 Mouse GE 8x60K Microarray") %>% 
  
  #Bind human data
  bind_rows(GSE124689_metadata_clean %>% 
               select(sample_id,
                      participant_id,
                      condition, timepoint,
                      sex, age, race, vaccine, 
                      sample_type, array, 
                      type, adjuvant) %>% 
              mutate(organism = "Human",
                     vaccine = "Fluad",
                     timepoint = as.character(timepoint)))

human_mouse_fluad_metadata

human_mouse_fluad_metadata %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "influenza_fluad_human_mouse_metadata.rds"))
```

##### By organism
```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=5}
#Visualize samples ------
demography_samples = human_mouse_fluad_metadata %>% 
  group_by(organism, timepoint, race) %>% 
  summarize(n = n()) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = as.character(timepoint)) 

demography_samples_plot = demography_samples %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = timepoint, 
      y = organism) +
  geom_point(aes(size = n,
                 fill = organism),
             pch = 22) +
  scale_size_binned(breaks = c(1, 10, 50),
                    range = c(2, 10)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Human"  = "#90A4AEFF",
    "Mouse" = "#4DBBD5FF",
    "FIT"   = "#4361ee"
  )) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Human"  = "#90A4AEFF",
    "Mouse" = "#4DBBD5FF",
    "FIT"   = "#4361ee"
  )) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(size = 1,
                                    linetype = 1,
                                    color = "black"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(size = 0.5,
                                    linetype = 2,
                                    color = "gray75"),
    axis.line.x = element_line(size = 0.5,
                               colour = "black",
                               linetype = 1),
    axis.line.y = element_line(size = 0,
                               colour = "black",
                               linetype = 1),
    axis.ticks.x = element_line(size = 1, color = "black"),
    axis.ticks.y = element_line(size = 0, color = "black"),
    plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0, unit = "cm")) +
  labs(x = "Days",
       y = "",
       size = "Samples",
       fill = "Organism")  +
  geom_label(aes(label = n),
             fill = "white",
             label.size = NA,
            size = 3,
            nudge_x = 0,
            nudge_y = 0.1,
            data = demography_samples %>% 
              filter(organism == "Human")) +
  geom_label(aes(label = n),
             fill = "white",
             label.size = NA,
            size = 3,
            nudge_x = 0,
            nudge_y = 0.1,
            data = demography_samples %>% 
              filter(organism == "Mouse")) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

#Print
demography_samples_plot

#Save
demography_samples_plot %>% 
  ggsave(filename = here("Figures", "influenza_fluad_human_mouse_demography.png"),
         width = 5,
         height = 5)

```

##### RLE plot
```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=18}
# Create a long format table
long_expr <- as.data.frame(human_mouse_fluad_matrix) %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  pivot_longer(-gene, names_to = "sample_id", values_to = "expression") %>%
  inner_join(human_mouse_fluad_metadata, by = "sample_id")

# Calculate the median for each gene by organism
long_expr <- long_expr %>%
  group_by(gene, organism) %>%
  mutate(gene_median = median(expression, na.rm = TRUE),
         RLE = expression - gene_median) %>%
  ungroup()

# Plot RLE
rle_plot <- ggplot(long_expr, aes(x = participant_id, y = RLE, fill = organism, color = organism)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.5) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.5, color = "red", fill = "red",
               data = long_expr %>% 
                 filter(participant_id %in% c("CRC305DGENT1483036",
                                           "CRC305DGENT0351013",
                                           "CRC305DGENT1471032"))) +
  facet_wrap(~paste("Day", timepoint),  ncol = 1) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  labs(title = "RLE Plot by Organism", y = "Relative Log Expression", x = "Sample") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 8),
        legend.position = "top") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(FIT = "#4361ee",
                               Mouse = "#4DBBD5FF",
                               Human = "#90A4AEFF"))+
  scale_color_manual(values = c(FIT = "#4361ee",
                                Mouse = "#4DBBD5FF",
                                Human = "#90A4AEFF")) 

# Print
print(rle_plot)

#Save
rle_plot %>% 
  ggsave(filename = here("Figures", "influenza_fluad_human_mouse_qc_rle_plot.png"),
         width = 18,
         height = 8)

beep()
```

#### Check distributions

##### From expression and log2fc
```{r}
#Raw expression + normalized
human_mouse_fluad_not_normalized = GSE124689_expression_not_normalized_log2_raw_symbol %>% 
  rownames_to_column("symbol") %>% 
  pivot_longer(-symbol,
               names_to = "sample_id",
               values_to = "value_raw") %>% 
  bind_rows(GSE120661_counts_not_normalized_log2_symbol %>% 
              pivot_longer(-symbol,
                names_to = "sample_id",
                values_to = "value_raw"))

#Annotate ------
human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn = human_mouse_fluad_matrix %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("symbol") %>% 
  pivot_longer(-symbol,
               names_to = "sample_id",
               values_to = "value_qn") %>% 
  inner_join(human_mouse_fluad_not_normalized, 
               by = join_by("symbol", "sample_id")) %>% 
  inner_join(human_mouse_fluad_metadata,
             by = "sample_id") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(value_qn, value_raw),
               names_to = "measure",
               values_to = "value")

#Save
human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "influenza_fluad_human_mouse_qc_raw_qn.rds"))

#Calculate the avg expression
human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn_avg = human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn %>% 
  group_by(symbol, organism, timepoint, measure) %>% 
  summarize(avg = mean(value),
            n_subjects = n(),
            sd = sd(value),
            se = sd/sqrt(n_subjects)) %>% 
  ungroup()

#Save
human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn_avg %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "influenza_fluad_human_mouse_qc_raw_qn_avg.rds"))


# Log2FoldChange ------
human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn_log2fc <- human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn %>%
  filter(measure %in% c("value_qn", "value_raw"),
         # timepoint %in% c(0, 1, 3, 7)
         ) %>%
  select(participant_id, symbol, timepoint, value, measure, organism) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = timepoint, values_from = value, names_prefix = "day_") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("day_"),
               names_to = "timepoint",
               names_prefix = "day_",
               values_to = "value") %>%
  group_by(participant_id, symbol, measure) %>% 
  mutate(day0 = value[timepoint == "0"]) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(log2fc = value - day0) %>%
  filter(timepoint != "0")

#Save
human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn_log2fc %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "influenza_fluad_human_mouse_qc_raw_qn_log2fc.rds"))

#Average L2FC
human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn_log2fc_avg = human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn_log2fc %>% 
  group_by(symbol, organism, timepoint, measure) %>% 
  summarize(avg_log2fc = mean(log2fc, na.rm = T),
            n_subjects = n(),
            #Dispersion
            sd = sd(value, na.rm = T),
            se = sd/sqrt(n_subjects),
            #Effect size
            effect_size = avg_log2fc/sd,
            #Get pval from paired t-test
    pval = tryCatch(t.test(value, day0, paired = TRUE)$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(ci_low = avg_log2fc - 1.96*se,
         ci_high = avg_log2fc + 1.96*se,
         pval_adj = p.adjust(pval, method = "fdr"))
  
#Save
human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn_log2fc_avg %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "influenza_fluad_human_mouse_qc_raw_qn_log2fc_avg.rds"))

beep()
```

Sanity check

```{r}
# Calculate quantiles for each sample and measure
quantile_summary <- human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn %>%
  group_by(sample_id, measure) %>%
  summarize(
    q0   = quantile(value, probs = 0.00, na.rm = TRUE),
    q25  = quantile(value, probs = 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q50  = quantile(value, probs = 0.50, na.rm = TRUE),
    q75  = quantile(value, probs = 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    q100 = quantile(value, probs = 1.00, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("q"), names_to = "quantile", values_to = "value")

# Plot the quantiles
ggplot(quantile_summary, aes(x = quantile %>% fct_relevel("q0", "q25", "q50", "q75","q100"), 
                             y = value, 
                             group = measure, 
                             color = measure)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3, position = position_dodge2(width = 0.2)) +
  labs(title = "Per-sample quantile distribution: raw vs. quantile-normalized",
       x = "Quantiles") +
  theme_vaxgo()

human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn %>%
  group_by(measure, organism, timepoint) %>%
  summarize(
    q0   = quantile(value, 0.00, na.rm = TRUE),
    q25  = quantile(value, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q50  = quantile(value, 0.50, na.rm = TRUE),
    q75  = quantile(value, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    q100 = quantile(value, 1.00, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) 
```

```{r fig.height=3, fig.width=3}
# --- 1) Mouse vs Human, matched timepoints ---
#Get timepoints
timepoints_human <- unique(human_mouse_log2fc_samples %>% filter(organism == "Human") %>% pull(timepoint))
timepoints_mouse <- timepoints_human

#Matched timepoints
timepoint_combinations <- tibble(timepoint_human = timepoints_human,
                                 timepoint_mouse = timepoints_mouse)

# Loop for matched timepoints
cor_human_mouse_timepoint <- timepoint_combinations %>%
  pmap_dfr(function(timepoint_human, timepoint_mouse) {
    
    # pegar os participantes do timepoint específico
    human_df <- human_mouse_log2fc_samples %>%
      filter(organism == "Human", timepoint == timepoint_human) %>%
      select(participant_id, human_symbol, log2fc)
    
    mouse_df <- human_mouse_log2fc_samples %>%
      filter(organism == "Mouse", timepoint == timepoint_mouse) %>%
      select(participant_id, human_symbol, log2fc)
    
    # manter apenas genes em comum
    common_genes <- intersect(human_df$human_symbol, mouse_df$human_symbol)
    human_df <- human_df %>% filter(human_symbol %in% common_genes)
    mouse_df <- mouse_df %>% filter(human_symbol %in% common_genes)
    
    # pivot para wide
    human_wide <- human_df %>% pivot_wider(names_from = participant_id, values_from = log2fc)
    mouse_wide <- mouse_df %>% pivot_wider(names_from = participant_id, values_from = log2fc)
    
    # IDs de participantes
    human_ids <- setdiff(colnames(human_wide), "human_symbol")
    mouse_ids <- setdiff(colnames(mouse_wide), "human_symbol")
    
    # calcular correlação para todos pares humano x mouse
    expand.grid(human = human_ids, mouse = mouse_ids, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
      mutate(
        cor_test = map2(human, mouse, ~{
          x <- human_wide[[.x]]
          y <- mouse_wide[[.y]]
          # remover NAs correspondentes
          keep <- complete.cases(x, y)
          cor.test(x[keep], y[keep], method = "pearson")
        }),
        r       = map_dbl(cor_test, ~.x$estimate),
        p_value = map_dbl(cor_test, ~.x$p.value),
        ci_low  = map_dbl(cor_test, ~.x$conf.int[1]),
        ci_high = map_dbl(cor_test, ~.x$conf.int[2])
      ) %>%
      select(-cor_test) %>%
      mutate(timepoint_human = timepoint_human,
             timepoint_mouse = timepoint_mouse)
  }) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint_human, timepoint_mouse) %>%
  summarize(
    comparison = "Human vs. Mouse",
    mean = mean(r, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd   = sd(r, na.rm = TRUE),
    n      = sum(!is.na(r)),
    se     = sd / sqrt(n),
    tval   = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
    ci_low = mean - tval * se,
    ci_high = mean + tval * se,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# --- 2) Human vs Human ---
cor_human_human <- human_mouse_log2fc_samples %>%
  filter(organism == "Human") %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>%
  group_modify(~{
    df <- .x %>%
      select(participant_id, human_symbol, log2fc) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = participant_id, values_from = log2fc) %>%
      select(-human_symbol)
    
    # Calculate correlation
    cor_mat <- cor(df, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "pearson")
    
    # Long format
    cor_long <- as.data.frame(cor_mat) %>%
      rownames_to_column("participant_1") %>%
      melt(id.vars = "participant_1", variable.name = "participant_2", value.name = "correlation") %>%
      filter(participant_1 != participant_2) %>%
      rowwise() %>%
      mutate(pair = paste(sort(c(participant_1, participant_2)), collapse = "_")) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      distinct(pair, .keep_all = TRUE)
    
    # Summary
    tibble(
      comparison = "Human vs. Human",
      mean = mean(cor_long$correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd   = sd(cor_long$correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
      n    = nrow(cor_long),
      se   = sd / sqrt(n),
      tval = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
      ci_low  = mean - tval * se,
      ci_high = mean + tval * se
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup()
  

# --- 3) Mouse vs Mouse ---
cor_mouse_mouse <- human_mouse_log2fc_samples %>%
  filter(organism == "Mouse") %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>%
  group_modify(~{
    df <- .x %>%
      select(participant_id, human_symbol, log2fc) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = participant_id, values_from = log2fc) %>%
      select(-human_symbol)
    
    # Calculate correlation
    cor_mat <- cor(df, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "pearson")
    
    # Long format
    cor_long <- as.data.frame(cor_mat) %>%
      rownames_to_column("participant_1") %>%
      melt(id.vars = "participant_1", variable.name = "participant_2", value.name = "correlation") %>%
      filter(participant_1 != participant_2) %>%
      rowwise() %>%
      mutate(pair = paste(sort(c(participant_1, participant_2)), collapse = "_")) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      distinct(pair, .keep_all = TRUE)
    
    # Summary
    tibble(
      comparison = "Mouse vs. Mouse",
      mean = mean(cor_long$correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd   = sd(cor_long$correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
      n    = nrow(cor_long),
      se   = sd / sqrt(n),
      tval = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
      ci_low  = mean - tval * se,
      ci_high = mean + tval * se
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup()


#Unite
correlation_long_all_mouse_human_timepoints_summary = cor_human_mouse_timepoint %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = timepoint_mouse) %>% 
  bind_rows(
    cor_human_human,
    cor_mouse_mouse)
```

###### Only human
```{r fig.height=10, fig.width=10, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, paged.print=TRUE}
#Calculate the correlation between participants
#Filters
organism_select = "Human"
measure_select = "value_raw"
timepoints_select = c(1, 3, 7)

correlation_long_all_timepoints <- human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn_log2fc %>%
  filter(
    organism == organism_select,
    measure == measure_select,
    timepoint %in% timepoints_select
  ) %>%
  select(timepoint, symbol, participant_id, log2fc) %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>%
  # Pivot wider and calculate correlation
  group_modify(~ {
    .x %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = participant_id, values_from = log2fc) %>%
      select(-symbol) %>%
      cor(use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "pearson") %>%
      as.data.frame() %>%
      rownames_to_column("participant1") %>%
      pivot_longer(-participant1, names_to = "participant2", values_to = "correlation") %>%
      filter(participant1 != participant2)
  }) %>%
  ungroup() 
  #Remove duplicate comparisons
  # mutate(
  #   participant_min = pmin(participant1, participant2),
  #   participant_max = pmax(participant1, participant2)
  # ) %>%
  # distinct(timepoint, participant_min, participant_max, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  # select(timepoint, participant1 = participant_min, participant2 = participant_max, correlation) %>% 
  # group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  # arrange(-correlation)

#Summarize data
correlation_long_all_timepoints %>% 
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  arrange(timepoint, -correlation) %>% 
  summarize(mean = mean(correlation, na.rm = T),
            median = median(correlation, na.rm = T),
            min = min(correlation, na.rm = T),
            max = max(correlation, na.rm = T),
            comparison = "Human vs Human") %>% 
  gt::gt()
```


```{r fig.height=10, fig.width=20, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, paged.print=TRUE}

#Plot heatmap
correlation_long_all_timepoints %>%
  filter(participant1 != participant2) %>%  # opcional: remove autocorrelações
  mutate(
    participant1 = factor(participant1, levels = sort(unique(participant1))),
    participant2 = factor(participant2, levels = sort(unique(participant2)))
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = participant1, y = participant2, fill = correlation)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  facet_grid(~timepoint) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#4575b4",     # azul
    mid = "white", 
    high = "#d73027",    # vermelho
    midpoint = 0,
    oob = scales::squish, 
    limits = c(-1, 1),
    name = "Pearson r"
  ) +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 1),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray90", color = NA),
    legend.position = "right"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Correlação entre participantes por timepoint",
    x = "Participante 1",
    y = "Participante 2"
  )
```

```{r}
#Boxplot by organism, averaged --------
distribution_check_avg_raw_qn_log2fc_boxplot = human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn_log2fc_avg %>%

  ggplot() +
  aes(y = avg_log2fc,

  geom_violin(aes(fill = organism)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "white",
```

##### Plot volcano plot
```{r fig.height=3, fig.width=16}
#Volcano plot -------
volcano_data <- human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn_log2fc_avg %>% 
  mutate(logp = -log10(pval_adj),
         sig = case_when(avg_log2fc > 0 & logp > 2 ~ "Up",
                         avg_log2fc < 0 & logp > 2 ~ "Down",
                         TRUE ~ "NS"),
         measure = case_when(measure == "value_qn" ~ "QN",
                             measure == "value_raw" ~ "Raw",
                             T~measure))
volcano_plot_raw_qn = volcano_data %>% 
ggplot() +
  aes(x = avg_log2fc, y = logp, fill = sig) +
  facet_nested(~paste("Day", timepoint)+organism + measure, scales = "free_y",  space = "free_y", nest_line = element_line(linetype = 1, color = "black")) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = sig,
                 color = sig),
             pch = 21, 
             size = 1, 
             alpha = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "black", linetype = 1, size = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 2, color = "black", linetype = 2, size = 0.5) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-1.5, 1.5)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(2, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60),
                     limits = c(0, 70),
                     expand = c(0.01, 0.01)) +
  guides(color = F) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Up" = "#165289", 
      "Down" = "#45efc6",
      "NS" = "gray80")) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Up" = "#165289", 
      "Down" = "#45efc6",
      "NS" = "gray80")) +
  labs(x = "Log2-Fold Change",
       y = "-log(FDR)",
       fill = "Direction") +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        legend.direction = "vertical",
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.key = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0))
```

```{r fig.height=4, fig.width=8}
  distinct()

#Get DEGs in human

  filter(pval_adj <= 0.05) %>%  #24.136 rows
  pull(symbol) %>% 
  unique()
```

```{r fig.width=10, fig.height=4}
#Get overlap -----
#Get symbols
degs_mouse_genes = degs_mouse %>% 
  select(human_symbol, timepoint) %>%

  select(human_symbol, timepoint) %>% 
  distinct()

degs_fit_genes = degs_fit %>% 
  select(human_symbol, timepoint) %>% 
  distinct()

#Inner join, Mouse and Human, Human and FIT ------

#Mouse
degs_human_and_mouse_genes = degs_human_genes %>% 
  inner_join(degs_mouse_genes, 
             by = join_by("human_symbol", "timepoint")) %>% 
  mutate(condition = "Mouse AND Human",
         comparison = "Mouse vs Human",
         organism = "Mouse",
         group = "Common")

#Duplicate rows for human
degs_human_and_mouse_genes_human = degs_human_and_mouse_genes %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Human")

#FIT
degs_human_and_fit_genes = degs_human_genes %>% 
  inner_join(degs_fit_genes, 
             by = join_by("human_symbol", "timepoint")) %>% 
  mutate(condition = "FIT AND Human",
         comparison = "FIT vs Human",
         organism = "FIT",
         group = "Common")

#Duplicate rows for human
degs_human_and_fit_genes_human = degs_human_and_fit_genes %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Human")

#Anti join, Human vs Mouse, Human vs FIT -------
#Human
#Human vs Mouse
degs_human_Not_mouse_genes = degs_human_genes %>% 
  anti_join(degs_mouse_genes, 
             by = join_by("human_symbol", "timepoint")) %>% 
  mutate(condition = "Human NOT Mouse", 
         comparison = "Mouse vs Human",
         organism = "Human",
         group = "Not common")
#Human vs FIT
degs_human_Not_fit_genes = degs_human_genes %>% 
  anti_join(degs_fit_genes, 
             by = join_by("human_symbol", "timepoint")) %>% 
  mutate(condition = "Human NOT FIT",
         organism = "Human",
         comparison = "FIT vs Human",
         group = "Not common")

#Models

degs_mouse_Not_human_genes = degs_mouse_genes %>% 
  anti_join(degs_human_genes, 
             by = join_by("human_symbol", "timepoint")) %>% 
  mutate(condition = "Mouse NOT Human",
         organism = "Mouse",
         comparison = "Mouse vs Human",
         group = "Not common")

#FIT vs Human

  anti_join(degs_human_genes,

  mutate(condition = "FIT NOT Human",
         organism = "FIT",
         comparison = "FIT vs Human",
         group = "Not common")

#Merge data ------
degs_human_mouse_overlap_genes = 
  bind_rows(degs_human_and_mouse_genes,
            degs_human_and_mouse_genes_human,
            degs_human_and_fit_genes,
```

## Get best and worst predicted genes

Which genes have the least zscore?

### Get by zscore

Get highly correlated genes and discretize by quantile

#### Mouse
```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=10}
#Get highly correlated genes and discretize by quantile -----
#By zscores ------
#Mouse
zscore_genes_mouse = pairwise_human_fit_measures %>% 
  select(human_symbol,timepoint,  mean_human, mean_mouse, pval_adj_mouse, pval_adj_human, z_score_h2m) %>% 
  arrange(z_score_h2m, human_symbol) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint) %>%
                    arrange(abs(z_score_h2m)) %>% 
  mutate(diff = mean_human - mean_mouse,
         diff = round(diff, 3),
         mean_human = round(mean_human, 3),
         mean_mouse = round(mean_mouse, 3),
         comparison = "Human vs Mouse") %>% 
  rename(zscore = z_score_h2m,
         mean_model = mean_mouse,
         pval_model_adj = pval_adj_mouse) %>% 
  
  #Discretize by quantile (zscore)
  mutate(
    quartile_label = cut(abs(zscore),
                         breaks = quantile(abs(zscore),
                                           probs = c(0, 0.10, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1),
                                           na.rm = TRUE),
                         include.lowest = TRUE,
                         labels = c("Q10", "Q25", "Q50", "Q75", "Q100")),
    timepoint_day = paste0("Day ", timepoint)) %>% 
  mutate(pval_model_adj = if_else(pval_model_adj <= 0.05, "DEG", "Not DEG"),
         pval_human_adj = if_else(pval_adj_human <= 0.05, "DEG", "Not DEG")) 

#Pivot and sum only DEGs
zscore_genes_mouse %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(human_symbol, timepoint, pval_model_adj, pval_human_adj) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(pval_model_adj, pval_human_adj),
               names_to =  "model",
               values_to = "deg") %>% 
  group_by(timepoint, model, deg) %>% 
  summarize(n = n()) %>% 
  filter(deg =="DEG")
```

####FIT
```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=10}
#FIT
zscore_genes_fit = pairwise_human_fit_measures %>% 
  select(human_symbol,timepoint,  mean_human, mean_fit, pval_adj_fit, pval_adj_human, z_score_h2fit) %>% 
  arrange(z_score_h2fit, human_symbol) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint) %>%
  arrange(abs(z_score_h2fit)) %>% 
  mutate(diff = mean_human - mean_fit,
         diff = round(diff, 3),
         mean_human = round(mean_human, 3),
         mean_fit = round(mean_fit, 3),
         comparison = "Human vs FIT") %>% 
  rename(zscore = z_score_h2fit,
         mean_model = mean_fit,
         pval_model_adj = pval_adj_fit) %>%
  
  #Discretize by quantile (zscore)
  mutate(quartile_label = cut(abs(zscore),
                         breaks = quantile(abs(zscore),
                                           probs = c(0, 0.10, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1),
                                           na.rm = TRUE),
                         include.lowest = TRUE,
                         labels = c("Q10", "Q25", "Q50", "Q75", "Q100")),
    timepoint_day = paste0("Day ", timepoint)) %>% 
    mutate(pval_model_adj = if_else(pval_model_adj <= 0.05, "DEG", "Not DEG"),
         pval_human_adj = if_else(pval_adj_human <= 0.05, "DEG", "Not DEG")) 

#Bind tables
```

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=10}
#Summarize genes by quantile ------
degs_pos_neg_summary_quantiles_best_worst_data <- zscore_genes %>%
  filter(pval_model_adj == pval_human_adj,
         pval_model_adj == "DEG") %>% 
  mutate(
    quartiles_grouped = case_when(
      quartile_label %in% c("Q10", "Q25") ~ "<=Q25",
      quartile_label %in% c("Q75", "Q100") ~ ">=Q75",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_)) %>%
  drop_na(quartiles_grouped) %>% 
  group_by(comparison, timepoint, quartiles_grouped) %>%
  summarize(n = n()) %>% 
  mutate(condition = case_when(comparison == "Human vs FIT" ~ paste("FIT", quartiles_grouped),
                               comparison == "Human vs Mouse" ~ paste("Mouse", quartiles_grouped),
                               T~comparison)) %>% 
  ungroup()
```

### Scatterplot of correlation
```{r fig.height=4, fig.width=8}
#Scatterplot of correlation --------
#Get all genes by quantile
quantiles <- zscore_genes %>%
  group_by(comparison) %>%
  summarise(
    q10  = quantile(abs(zscore), probs = 0.10, na.rm = TRUE),
    q25  = quantile(abs(zscore), probs = 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q50  = quantile(abs(zscore), probs = 0.50, na.rm = TRUE),
    q75  = quantile(abs(zscore), probs = 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    q100 = quantile(abs(zscore), probs = 1.00, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

#Cumulative quantiles
diff_correlation_plot_data <- zscore_genes %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(quantiles, by = "comparison") %>%
  mutate(
    Q10  = abs(zscore) <= q10,
    Q25  = abs(zscore) <= q25,
    Q50  = abs(zscore) <= q50,
    Q75  = abs(zscore) <= q75,
    Q100 = abs(zscore) <= q100
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Q10, Q25, Q50, Q75, Q100),
    names_to = "quantile_label_grouped",
    values_to = "in_quantile"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    quantile_label_grouped = fct_relevel(quantile_label_grouped, "Q10", "Q25", "Q50", "Q75", "Q100")
  ) %>%
  filter(in_quantile) %>%
  select(-in_quantile)

#Print
diff_correlation_plot_data

  ungroup() %>% 
  select(human_symbol, timepoint, pval_model_adj, pval_human_adj, comparison) %>%

               names_to =  "model",
               values_to = "deg") %>% 
  group_by(comparison, model, timepoint, deg) %>% 
  summarize(n = n()) %>% 
  filter(deg =="DEG")
```

```{r fig.height=4, fig.width=8}
   #Guide lines
  geom_abline(alpha = 0.2, linetype = 2) +

        legend.title = element_text(size = 10, vjust = 0.9),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 7, vjust = 0.5, hjust = -0.2)) +
  labs(x = "Mouse L2FC",
       y = "Human L2FC",
       alpha = "Quantiles",
```

### Enrichment analysis of genes in best and worst quartiles

```{r fig.width=10, fig.height= 8}
# Enrichment analysis -------
organism = "org.Hs.eg.db"
#Hallmarks
#Retrieve human H (hallmark) gene set
msigdbr_raw <- msigdbr(species = "human", category = "H") 
#Clean
msigdbr_df = msigdbr_raw %>% 
  select(process = gs_name, genes = gene_symbol) %>% 
  mutate(process = str_remove(process, "HALLMARK_"))

#Discretize by quartile
df_genes_best_worst_fit_mouse = zscore_genes %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(quartiles_grouped = case_when(
    quartile_label %in% c("Q10", "Q25") ~ "<Q25",
    quartile_label %in% c("Q75", "Q100") ~ ">Q75",
    TRUE ~ quartile_label)) %>% 
    mutate(condition = paste0(comparison, "", quartiles_grouped, " (", timepoint_day,")")) %>% 
  filter(quartiles_grouped != "Q50") %>% 
  select(genes = human_symbol,
         condition)

#Run ORA Hallmarks
ora_all_diff_hallmark <- enricher_condition(
  df = df_genes_best_worst_fit_mouse,
  term2gene_df = msigdbr_df) %>% 
  mutate(log_p_adjust = -log(p_adjust)) %>% 
  mutate(description = str_replace_all(description, "_", " ")) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = str_extract(condition, "(?<=\\(Day )\\d+")) %>% 
  mutate(comparison = case_when(str_detect(condition, "FIT") ~ "FIT",
                                str_detect(condition, "Mouse") ~ "Mouse"))

#Save
ora_all_diff_hallmark %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("GSEA_ORA", "ora_all_diff_hallmark.rds"))

#Print
ora_all_diff_hallmark
```


##### Plot ORA Hallmark
```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=8}
##### Plot ORA Hallmark ------
#Import
ora_all_diff_hallmark = readRDS(file = here("GSEA_ORA", "ora_all_diff_hallmark.rds"))
#Cluster rows
row_clustered = ora_all_diff_hallmark %>% 
    dplyr::select(condition, description, log_p_adjust) %>% 
    distinct() %>% 
    pivot_wider(names_from = "condition",
                values_from= "log_p_adjust") %>%
    column_to_rownames("description") %>% 
    as.matrix() %>% 
    replace(is.na(.), 0) %>% 
    dist(.) %>% 
    hclust()

#Plot
ora_all_diff_hallmark_heatmap = ora_all_diff_hallmark %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  filter(description %in% c(row_clustered$labels)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(condition, description, log_p_adjust, p_adjust, everything()) %>% 
    mutate(signific = case_when(p_adjust <= 0.10 ~ "*",
                              p_adjust <= 0.25 ~ "-",
                              p_adjust <= 0.50 ~ "/",
                              p_adjust <= 0.05 ~ "**",
                              TRUE ~ ""),
           quantile = str_extract(condition, "Q\\d{2,3}"),
        condition = paste(quantile)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=condition, y = str_to_upper(description), fill = log_p_adjust)) +
  geom_tile(color = "black", 
            size = 0.2, na.rm = F, stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = signific), size = 4, vjust = 0.5, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
        low = "white",     
        high = "#4DBBD5FF",   
        n.breaks = 3,
        oob = scales::squish,
        limits = c(0, 4),      # fixa o intervalo
        name = "-Log(FDR)") +
    theme_vaxgo() +
    theme(axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 8) ,
          legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
          legend.title = element_text(size = 8),
          legend.key.width = unit(0.2, 'cm'),
          legend.key.height = unit(0.4, 'cm'),
          axis.line.y  = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, vjust = 1, hjust=0.5),
          axis.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1),
          axis.ticks = element_blank(),
          strip.background.x = element_rect(fill = "black"),
          strip.text.x = element_text(color = "white"),
          panel.grid = element_blank(),
          plot.margin = margin(0, 0.5, 0, 1, unit = "cm"),
          legend.direction = "horizontal",
          legend.position = "top") +
    scale_y_discrete(position = "right") +
     labs(x = "",
         y = "",
         title = "ORA, MSigDB Hallmarks") +
  facet_nested(~ paste("Day", timepoint) + fct_rev(comparison), scales = "free", space = "free")
```

## Top best and worst

```{r}
#Import data
pairwise_human_fit_measures = readRDS(here("tables", "influenza_fluad_human_mouse_fit_dge_pairwise2human.rds")) 
ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genes = read_csv(file = here("VaxGO", "ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genes.csv"))
# Top best and worst predicted genes in FIT and Mouse -----
pairwise_human_fit_genes_long =  pairwise_human_fit_measures %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(mean_human, mean_mouse, mean_fit),
               values_to = "l2fc",
               names_to = "organism") %>% 
  rename(diff_h2m = human_2_mouse,
         diff_h2fit = human_2_fit) %>% 
  mutate(organism = if_else(organism == "FIT Prediction", "FIT", organism)) %>% 
  
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(symbol, timepoint, organism),
               values_to = "value",
               names_to = "metric") %>% 
  mutate(
    organism = case_when(
      str_detect(metric, "human") ~ "Human",
      str_detect(metric, "fit") ~ "FIT",
      str_detect(metric, "mouse") ~ "Mouse",
      metric == "Human" ~ "Human",
      metric == "FIT Prediction" ~ "FIT",
      TRUE ~ organism),
    metric = str_remove_all(metric, "_?(human|mouse|fit)$"),
    metric = str_remove_all(metric, "_?(human|mouse|fit)")
  ) %>% 
  mutate(organism = case_when(str_detect(metric, "h2m") ~ "Mouse",
                              str_detect(metric, "h2") ~ "FIT",
                              T~organism))  %>% 
  mutate(organism = case_when(organism == "mean_fit" ~ "FIT",
                              organism == "mean_human" ~ "Human",
                              organism == "mean_mouse" ~ "Mouse",
                              T ~ organism))

#Comparisons
pairwise_human_fit_measures_comparisons = pairwise_human_fit_measures %>%
    select(timepoint, symbol, human_2_mouse:effect_size_h2m) 

#Pivot table and join the comparisons
pairwise_human_fit_genes_wide = pairwise_human_fit_genes_long %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "metric",
              values_from = "value", 
              values_fn = mean) %>% 
  select(!c(pval:effect_size_h2m)) %>% 
  inner_join(pairwise_human_fit_measures_comparisons,
                by = join_by("timepoint", "symbol")) 


#Get top genes in each model
top_genes_human = pairwise_human_fit_genes_wide %>% 
  filter(organism == "Human") %>% 
  relocate(ci_width,  .after = organism) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  arrange(ci_width) 
  
 top_genes_mouse = pairwise_human_fit_genes_wide %>% 
  filter(organism == "Mouse",
         symbol %in% c(top_genes_human$symbol)) %>% 
   arrange(ci_width, desc(p_value_h2m_adj), human_2_mouse)
 
 top_genes_fit = pairwise_human_fit_genes_wide %>% 
  filter(organism == "FIT",
         symbol %in% c(top_genes_human$symbol)) %>% 
   arrange(ci_width, desc(p_value_h2fit_adj), human_2_fit)
```

```{r fig.height=7, fig.width=8}
                               select(symbol) %>% 
                               distinct() %>% 
                               slice_head(n = 5) %>% 
                               pull(symbol))) %>% 
  arrange(symbol, timepoint) %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = timepoint,
      y = l2fc,
      color = organism,
      fill = organism) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "gray75", alpha = 1, linetype = 2) +
  geom_line(aes(group = organism), position = position_dodge2(1)) +
  facet_wrap(~symbol, nrow = 1) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ci_low, 
                  ymax = ci_high),
                position =  position_dodge(1), show.legend = F
                ) +
      geom_point( position = position_dodge(1),
             color = "black",
             pch = 21) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(1, 3, 7),minor_breaks = F) +
    scale_color_manual(
  values = c(
    "FIT" = "#4361ee", 
    Mouse = "#4DBBD5FF",
    Human = "#546E7AFF"))+
  scale_fill_manual(
  values = c(
    "FIT" = "#4361ee", 
    Mouse = "#4DBBD5FF",
    Human = "#546E7AFF"))+
    theme_vaxgo() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0),
        strip.text.x = element_text(color = "black"),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray95", color = NA), 
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()) +
  labs(color = "Organism",
       x = "Time (days)",
       y = "LogFold-Change",
       title = "Top 5 FIT genes with lowest CI widths and l2fc differences to human l2fc, with highest padj")

fit_example_human_plot_fit
```

#### Get ranks
```{r}
#Get ranks -----
#Mouse
ranks_mouse = pairwise_human_fit_genes_wide %>%
  filter(organism == "Mouse") %>%
  select(symbol, timepoint, z_score_h2m, organism) %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  arrange(timepoint, abs(z_score_h2m)) %>%
  mutate(percent_rank = percent_rank(abs(z_score_h2m)),
         percentile = round(percent_rank * 100, 2)) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  rename(zscore_h2model = z_score_h2m)
#FIT
ranks_fit = pairwise_human_fit_genes_wide %>%
  filter(organism == "FIT") %>%
  select(symbol, timepoint, z_score_h2fit, organism) %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  arrange(timepoint, abs(z_score_h2fit)) %>%
  mutate(percent_rank = percent_rank(abs(z_score_h2fit)),
         percentile = round(percent_rank * 100, 2)) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  rename(zscore_h2model = z_score_h2fit)

#Fit vs Mouse
ranks_fit_vs_mouse = ranks_fit %>% 
  select(symbol, fit = percentile, timepoint_ref = timepoint, zscore_h2fit = zscore_h2model) %>% 
  inner_join(ranks_mouse %>% 
               select(symbol, mouse = percentile,
                      timepoint_other = timepoint,
                      zscore_h2mouse = zscore_h2model),
             by = "symbol") %>% 
  mutate(timepoint_ref = as.character(timepoint_ref),
         timepoint_other = as.character(timepoint_other),
         condition = "Top FIT vs Mouse")

#Mouse vs FIT
ranks_mouse_vs_fit = ranks_mouse %>% 
  select(symbol, mouse = percentile, timepoint_ref = timepoint, zscore_h2mouse = zscore_h2model) %>% 
  inner_join(ranks_fit %>% 
               select(symbol, fit = percentile,
                      timepoint_other = timepoint,
                      zscore_h2fit = zscore_h2model),
             by = "symbol") %>% 
  mutate(timepoint_ref = as.character(timepoint_ref),
         timepoint_other = as.character(timepoint_other),
         condition = "Top Mouse vs FIT")


#Get genes that are in the 10th percentile in one model, but are in the 90th percentile in the other
ranks_best_fit_and_mouse = ranks_fit_vs_mouse %>%
  filter(fit < 10, mouse > 90) %>%
  bind_rows(ranks_mouse_vs_fit %>%
              filter(mouse < 10, fit > 90)) %>%
  select(condition,
         symbol,
         timepoint_ref,
         timepoint_other, 
         fit, zscore_h2fit,
         mouse, zscore_h2mouse)

ranks_best_fit_and_mouse_long <- ranks_best_fit_and_mouse %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(fit, mouse),
    names_to = "model",
    values_to = "percentile"
  )


#Get genes with least zscores in one model, but have the highest zscore in the other
ranks_best_fit_and_mouse_zscore = ranks_fit_vs_mouse %>%

  # FILTER BY N
  filter(timepoint_ref == timepoint_other) %>%
  arrange(abs(zscore_h2fit), desc(abs(zscore_h2mouse))) %>%
  slice_head(n = 20) %>% 
  bind_rows(ranks_mouse_vs_fit %>%
              filter(timepoint_ref == timepoint_other) %>%
  arrange(abs(zscore_h2mouse), desc(abs(zscore_h2fit))) %>%
  slice_head(n = 20)) %>%
  select(condition,
         symbol,
         timepoint_ref,
         timepoint_other, 
         fit = zscore_h2fit,
         mouse = zscore_h2mouse)
#Pivot longer
ranks_best_fit_and_mouse_long_zscore <- ranks_best_fit_and_mouse_zscore %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(fit, mouse),
    names_to = "model",
    values_to = "zscore"
  )

ranks_best_fit_and_mouse_long_zscore
```

```{r}
# Import datasets

         condition = paste0(organism, "_", timepoint)) %>% 
  distinct()
btm_annotation_genes = read_csv(file = here("tables", "btm_annotation_genes.csv"))

# DEGs table
degs_all_updown = dge_long_genes %>% 
  dplyr::filter(organism %in% c("Human", "Mouse")) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(adj_p_val <= 0.05) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(condition = paste0(organism, "_", timepoint)) %>% 
  dplyr::select(process = condition, genes = human_symbol) 

# Metadata
annotation_metadata = dge_long_genes %>% 
  #Arrange columns in the desired order to be displayed on the heatmap
  dplyr::select(condition, 
                organism, 
                # type, 
                # vaccine, 
                timepoint) %>% 
  distinct()

annotation_metadata$condition %>% unique()
#Inputs
filename = "hepatitisb_engerixb"
```

Perform calculations

```{r}
conflicted::conflicts_prefer(base::intersect)
conflicted::conflicts_prefer(base::setdiff)

# Perform calculations
unique_cond <- unique(degs_all_updown$process) # List sets
shared_genes_df <- data.frame() # Store data

for (i in 1:(length(unique_cond) - 1)) {
  for (j in (i + 1):length(unique_cond)) {
    results_temp <- overlap_genes(unique_cond[i], unique_cond[j], degs_all_updown)
    shared_genes_df <- bind_rows(shared_genes_df, results_temp)
  }
}

# Fisher's exact test
fisher_exact_test <- function(shared, notshared1, notshared2) {
  cont_table <- matrix(c(shared, notshared1, notshared2, 0), nrow = 2)
  results_fisher <- stats::fisher.test(cont_table)
  return(results_fisher$p.value)
}
shared_genes_df = shared_genes_df %>%
  mutate(pvalue = pmap_dbl(list(Shared, NotShared_cond1, NotShared_cond2), fisher_exact_test),
         p_adj = p.adjust(pvalue))


#Mirror table
shared_genes_df2 = shared_genes_df %>% 
  dplyr::rename(Cond1_temp = Cond1, Cond2_temp = Cond2) %>%
  dplyr::rename(Cond1 = Cond2_temp, Cond2 = Cond1_temp)

shared_genes_df_mirror = shared_genes_df %>% 
  dplyr::bind_rows(shared_genes_df2) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(Percentage_Shared_Cond1 = round(Percentage_Shared_Cond1, 2),
         Percentage_Shared_Cond2 = round(Percentage_Shared_Cond2, 2))
  
#Jaccard distance
jaccard.matrix <- degs_all_updown %>%
  dplyr::mutate(present = 1) %>% 
  dplyr::distinct() %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = genes, values_from = present, values_fill = 0) %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "process") %>%
  vegan::vegdist(binary = TRUE, method = "jaccard", diag = TRUE, upper = TRUE) %>%
  as.matrix() %>%
  {1 - .}
shared_genes_df_mirror = jaccard.matrix %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("Cond1") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -"Cond1",
               names_to = "Cond2",
               values_to = "jaccard_distance") %>% 
  inner_join(shared_genes_df_mirror, by = join_by(Cond1, Cond2)) %>% 
  mutate(jaccard_distance = round(jaccard_distance, 3))

#Save
write_csv(shared_genes_df_mirror, 
          file = here("Tables", paste0(filename, "_sharedgenes_Fisher_Jaccard.csv")))
shared_genes_df_mirror
```

```{r}
shared_genes_df_mirror = read_csv(file = here("Tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_sharedgenes_Fisher_Jaccard.csv"))

matrix_data = shared_genes_df_mirror %>%

        value.var = "Shared", 
        fun.aggregate = mean) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("Cond1") %>%
  mutate_if(is.character, as.numeric) %>% 
  as.matrix() 

# Create a matrix of p-values
pvalue_matrix <- shared_genes_df_mirror %>%
  dcast(Cond1 ~ Cond2,
        value.var = "p_adj",
        fun.aggregate = mean) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Cond1") %>%

# merge

                         cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
  if (!is.na(mat[i, j]) && mat[i, j] > 0) {
    grid.text(sprintf("%.f", mat[i, j]), x, y, gp = gpar(fontsize = 8, color = "white"))
  }
                           i# Add significance stars based on p-value thresholds
  if (!is.na(pvalue_matrix[i, j])) {
    pval <- pvalue_matrix[i, j]
    sig <- ""
    if (pval < 0.01) {
      sig <- "***"
    } else if (pval < 0.05) {
      sig <- "**"
    } else if (pval < 0.10) {
      sig <- "*"
    }
    
    # Draw the symbol slightly above the cell center
    if (sig != "") {
      grid.text(sig, x, y + unit(2, "mm"), gp = gpar(fontsize = 6, fontface = "plain", color = "white"))
    }
  }
},

row_names_rot = 0,
```

###Plot correlation
```{r}
#Import
human_mouse_log2fc_samples =
  readRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_human_mouse_exprs_samples_log2fc.rds"))

human_mouse_engerix_metadata =
  readRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_human_mouse_metadata.rds"))

all_degs_human = readRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_human_dge_limma_degs.rds")) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = str_remove(comparison_a, "Time"))
all_degs_mouse = readRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_mouse_degs_mouse.rds")) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = str_remove(condition, "Engerix_") %>% str_remove("_PBMC") %>% as.numeric(),
         timepoint = timepoint /24,
         timepoint = timepoint %>% as.character())



#Pivot wider
human_mouse_engerixb_log2fc_avg_wide = all_degs_human %>% 
  bind_rows(all_degs_mouse) %>% 
  select(organism, human_symbol, timepoint, mean_log2fc = mean_l2fc) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "organism",
              values_from = "mean_log2fc") %>% 
  #Add padj columns
  inner_join(all_degs_human %>%
               bind_rows(all_degs_mouse) %>% 
               select(organism, human_symbol, timepoint, adj_p_val) %>%
               pivot_wider(names_from = "organism",
                           values_from = "adj_p_val") %>%
               rename(padj_human = Human, padj_mouse = Mouse)) %>% 
  #Drop genes that are absent in one of the organisms 
  drop_na()

# Calculate the correlation
cor_data <- human_mouse_engerixb_log2fc_avg_wide %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  filter(padj_human <= 0.05 | padj_human <= 0.05) %>%
  summarize(
    cor_value = cor(Mouse, Human, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs"),
    label_pos_x = max(Mouse, na.rm = TRUE),
    label_pos_y = max(Human, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(label = paste0("r = ", round(cor_value, 2)))
```

```{r fig.height=3, fig.width=3}
# --- 1) Mouse vs Human, matched timepoints ---
#Get timepoints
timepoints_human <- unique(human_mouse_log2fc_samples %>% filter(organism == "Human") %>% pull(timepoint))
timepoints_mouse <- unique(human_mouse_log2fc_samples %>% filter(organism == "Mouse") %>% pull(timepoint))

#Matched timepoints
timepoint_combinations <- tibble(timepoint_human = timepoints_human,
                                      timepoint_mouse = timepoints_mouse)

# Loop for matched timepoints
cor_human_mouse_timepoint <- timepoint_combinations %>%
  pmap_dfr(function(timepoint_human, timepoint_mouse) {
    
    # pegar os participantes do timepoint específico
    human_df <- human_mouse_log2fc_samples %>%
      filter(organism == "Human", timepoint == timepoint_human) %>%
      select(participant_id, human_symbol, log2fc)
    
    mouse_df <- human_mouse_log2fc_samples %>%
      filter(organism == "Mouse", timepoint == timepoint_mouse) %>%
      select(participant_id, human_symbol, log2fc)
    
    # manter apenas genes em comum
    common_genes <- intersect(human_df$human_symbol, mouse_df$human_symbol)
    human_df <- human_df %>% filter(human_symbol %in% common_genes)
    mouse_df <- mouse_df %>% filter(human_symbol %in% common_genes)
    
    # pivot para wide
    human_wide <- human_df %>% pivot_wider(names_from = participant_id, values_from = log2fc)
    mouse_wide <- mouse_df %>% pivot_wider(names_from = participant_id, values_from = log2fc)
    
    # IDs de participantes
    human_ids <- setdiff(colnames(human_wide), "human_symbol")
    mouse_ids <- setdiff(colnames(mouse_wide), "human_symbol")
    
    # calcular correlação para todos pares humano x mouse
    expand.grid(human = human_ids, mouse = mouse_ids, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
      mutate(
        cor_test = map2(human, mouse, ~{
          x <- human_wide[[.x]]
          y <- mouse_wide[[.y]]
          # remover NAs correspondentes
          keep <- complete.cases(x, y)
          cor.test(x[keep], y[keep], method = "pearson")
        }),
        r       = map_dbl(cor_test, ~.x$estimate),
        p_value = map_dbl(cor_test, ~.x$p.value),
        ci_low  = map_dbl(cor_test, ~.x$conf.int[1]),
        ci_high = map_dbl(cor_test, ~.x$conf.int[2])
      ) %>%
      select(-cor_test) %>%
      mutate(timepoint_human = timepoint_human,
             timepoint_mouse = timepoint_mouse)
  }) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint_human, timepoint_mouse) %>%
  summarize(
    comparison = "Human vs. Mouse",
    mean = mean(r, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd   = sd(r, na.rm = TRUE),
    n      = sum(!is.na(r)),
    se     = sd / sqrt(n),
    tval   = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
    ci_low = mean - tval * se,
    ci_high = mean + tval * se,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# --- 2) Human vs Human ---
cor_human_human <- human_mouse_log2fc_samples %>%
  filter(organism == "Human") %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>%
  group_modify(~{
    df <- .x %>%
      select(participant_id, human_symbol, log2fc) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = participant_id, values_from = log2fc) %>%
      select(-human_symbol)
    
    # Calculate correlation
    cor_mat <- cor(df, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "pearson")
    
    # Long format
    cor_long <- as.data.frame(cor_mat) %>%
      rownames_to_column("participant_1") %>%
      melt(id.vars = "participant_1", variable.name = "participant_2", value.name = "correlation") %>%
      filter(participant_1 != participant_2) %>%
      rowwise() %>%
      mutate(pair = paste(sort(c(participant_1, participant_2)), collapse = "_")) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      distinct(pair, .keep_all = TRUE)
    
    # Summary
    tibble(
      comparison = "Human vs. Human",
      mean = mean(cor_long$correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd   = sd(cor_long$correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
      n    = nrow(cor_long),
      se   = sd / sqrt(n),
      tval = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
      ci_low  = mean - tval * se,
      ci_high = mean + tval * se
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

      rownames_to_column("participant_1") %>%
      melt(id.vars = "participant_1", variable.name = "participant_2", value.name = "correlation") %>%
      filter(participant_1 != participant_2) %>%
      rowwise() %>%
      mutate(pair = paste(sort(c(participant_1, participant_2)), collapse = "_")) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      distinct(pair, .keep_all = TRUE)
    
    # Summary
    tibble(
      comparison = "Mouse vs. Mouse",
      mean = mean(cor_long$correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd   = sd(cor_long$correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
```

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=5}
cor_data <- dge_btm_mean_process %>%
  # Group the data by timepoint
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  
  # For each timepoint, run Pearson correlation test between Mouse and Human
  summarize(
    cor_test = list(cor.test(Mouse, Human, method = "spearman")), # store full test result as a list
    label_pos_x = max(Mouse, na.rm = TRUE),  # position for label in the plot (x = max Mouse value)
    label_pos_y = max(Human, na.rm = TRUE),  # position for label in the plot (y = max Human value)
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  
  # Extract correlation coefficient (r) and p-value from cor_test, and create a label
  mutate(
    cor_value = map_dbl(cor_test, ~ .x$estimate),  
    p_value   = map_dbl(cor_test, ~ .x$p.value),  
    label = paste0(
      "r = ", round(cor_value, 2),      
      ", p = ", signif(p_value, 3)   
    )
  )
```

```{r}
# Import datasets
dge_long_genes = read_rds(file = here("tables", "saureus_infection_human_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds"))

# DEGs table
degs_all_updown = dge_long_genes %>% 
  dplyr::filter(organism %in% c("Human", "Mouse")) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(adj_p_val <= 0.05) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(condition = paste0(organism, "_", timepoint)) %>% 
  dplyr::select(process = condition, genes = human_symbol)

# Metadata
annotation_metadata = dge_long_genes %>% 
  #Arrange columns in the desired order to be displayed on the heatmap
  dplyr::select(condition, 
                organism, 
                # type, 
                # vaccine, 
                timepoint) %>% 
  mutate(condition = paste0(organism, "_", timepoint))

annotation_metadata$condition %>% unique()
#Inputs
filename = "saureus_infection"
```

Perform calculations

```{r}
conflicted::conflicts_prefer(base::intersect)
conflicted::conflicts_prefer(base::setdiff)

# Perform calculations
unique_cond <- unique(degs_all_updown$process) # List sets
shared_genes_df <- data.frame() # Store data

for (i in 1:(length(unique_cond) - 1)) {
  for (j in (i + 1):length(unique_cond)) {
    results_temp <- overlap_genes(unique_cond[i], unique_cond[j], degs_all_updown)
    shared_genes_df <- bind_rows(shared_genes_df, results_temp)
  }
}

# Fisher's exact test
fisher_exact_test <- function(shared, notshared1, notshared2) {
  cont_table <- matrix(c(shared, notshared1, notshared2, 0), nrow = 2)
  results_fisher <- stats::fisher.test(cont_table)
  return(results_fisher$p.value)
}
shared_genes_df = shared_genes_df %>%
  mutate(pvalue = pmap_dbl(list(Shared, NotShared_cond1, NotShared_cond2), fisher_exact_test),
         p_adj = p.adjust(pvalue))


#Mirror table
shared_genes_df2 = shared_genes_df %>% 
  dplyr::rename(Cond1_temp = Cond1, Cond2_temp = Cond2) %>%
  dplyr::rename(Cond1 = Cond2_temp, Cond2 = Cond1_temp)

shared_genes_df_mirror = shared_genes_df %>% 
  dplyr::bind_rows(shared_genes_df2) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(Percentage_Shared_Cond1 = round(Percentage_Shared_Cond1, 2),
         Percentage_Shared_Cond2 = round(Percentage_Shared_Cond2, 2))
  
#Jaccard distance
jaccard.matrix <- degs_all_updown %>%
  dplyr::mutate(present = 1) %>% 
  dplyr::distinct() %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = genes, values_from = present, values_fill = 0) %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "process") %>%
  vegan::vegdist(binary = TRUE, method = "jaccard", diag = TRUE, upper = TRUE) %>%
  as.matrix() %>%
  {1 - .}
shared_genes_df_mirror = jaccard.matrix %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("Cond1") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -"Cond1",
               names_to = "Cond2",
               values_to = "jaccard_distance") %>% 
  inner_join(shared_genes_df_mirror, by = join_by(Cond1, Cond2)) %>% 
  mutate(jaccard_distance = round(jaccard_distance, 3))

#Save
write_csv(shared_genes_df_mirror, 
          file = here("Tables", paste0(filename, "_sharedgenes_Fisher_Jaccard.csv")))
shared_genes_df_mirror
```

```{r}
    if (pval < 0.01) {
      sig <- "***"
    } else if (pval < 0.05) {
      sig <- "**"
    } else if (pval < 0.10) {
      sig <- "*"
    }
    
    # Draw the symbol slightly above the cell center
    if (sig != "") {
      grid.text(sig, x, y + unit(2, "mm"), gp = gpar(fontsize = 6, fontface = "plain", color = "white"))
    }
  }
},
                        column_title = fileimageheatmap_grouped,
                        column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 15, fontface = "bold"),
                        column_names_rot = 45,
row_names_rot = 0,
                        column_names_gp = column_names_gp,
                        cluster_rows = TRUE,
                        rect_gp = rect_gp,
                        row_names_gp = row_names_gp,
                        # row_split = 2, #Split row clusters
                        row_gap = unit(2, "mm"),
                        cluster_columns = TRUE,
                        na_col = "black",
                        column_split = NULL, #Split group clusters
                        #column_km = 3,
                        column_gap = unit(8, "mm"),
                        show_column_dend = F,
                        show_row_dend = F,
                        row_dend_side = "left",
                        column_dend_side = "top",
                        clustering_distance_rows = "euclidean",
                        border = TRUE,
                        column_dend_reorder = TRUE,
                        width = width, 
                        height = height
)

draw(heatmap_plot_all,  heatmap_legend_side = "left", annotation_legend_side = "left")

dev.off()
```

#### Plot correlation between genes (log2fc for every sample)


```{r fig.height=3, fig.width=3}
# --- 1) Mouse vs Human no mesmo timepoint ---
#Get timepoints
timepoints_human <- unique(human_mouse_log2fc_samples %>% filter(organism == "Human") %>% pull(timepoint))
timepoints_mouse <- unique(human_mouse_log2fc_samples %>% filter(organism == "Mouse") %>% pull(timepoint))

#Get combinations
timepoint_combinations <- expand.grid(timepoint_human = timepoints_human,
                                      timepoint_mouse = timepoints_mouse,
                                      stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Loop
cor_human_mouse_timepoint <- timepoint_combinations %>%
  pmap_dfr(function(timepoint_human, timepoint_mouse) {
    
    # pegar os participantes do timepoint específico
    human_df <- human_mouse_log2fc_samples %>%
      filter(organism == "Human", timepoint == timepoint_human) %>%
      select(participant_id, human_symbol, log2fc)
    
    mouse_df <- human_mouse_log2fc_samples %>%
      filter(organism == "Mouse", timepoint == timepoint_mouse) %>%
      select(participant_id, human_symbol, log2fc)
    
    # manter apenas genes em comum
    common_genes <- intersect(human_df$human_symbol, mouse_df$human_symbol)
    human_df <- human_df %>% filter(human_symbol %in% common_genes)
    mouse_df <- mouse_df %>% filter(human_symbol %in% common_genes)
    
    # pivot para wide
    human_wide <- human_df %>% pivot_wider(names_from = participant_id, values_from = log2fc)
    mouse_wide <- mouse_df %>% pivot_wider(names_from = participant_id, values_from = log2fc)
    
    # IDs de participantes
    human_ids <- setdiff(colnames(human_wide), "human_symbol")
    mouse_ids <- setdiff(colnames(mouse_wide), "human_symbol")
    
    # calcular correlação para todos pares humano x mouse
    expand.grid(human = human_ids, mouse = mouse_ids, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
      mutate(
        cor_test = map2(human, mouse, ~{
          x <- human_wide[[.x]]
          y <- mouse_wide[[.y]]
          # remover NAs correspondentes
          keep <- complete.cases(x, y)
          cor.test(x[keep], y[keep], method = "pearson")
        }),
        r       = map_dbl(cor_test, ~.x$estimate),
        p_value = map_dbl(cor_test, ~.x$p.value),
        ci_low  = map_dbl(cor_test, ~.x$conf.int[1]),
        ci_high = map_dbl(cor_test, ~.x$conf.int[2])
      ) %>%
      select(-cor_test) %>%
      mutate(timepoint_human = timepoint_human,
             timepoint_mouse = timepoint_mouse)
  }) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint_human, timepoint_mouse) %>%
  summarize(
    comparison = "Human vs. Mouse",
    mean = mean(r, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd   = sd(r, na.rm = TRUE),
    n      = sum(!is.na(r)),
    se     = sd / sqrt(n),
    tval   = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
    ci_low = mean - tval * se,
    ci_high = mean + tval * se,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# --- 2) Human vs Human (entre timepoints) ---
cor_human_human <- human_mouse_log2fc_samples %>%
  filter(organism == "Human") %>%
  select(participant_id, human_symbol, timepoint, log2fc) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = participant_id,
    values_from = log2fc
  ) %>%
  select(-human_symbol, -timepoint) %>%   # só colunas de participantes
  cor(use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "pearson") %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("participant_1") %>%
  melt(id.vars = "participant_1", variable.name = "participant_2", value.name = "correlation") %>% 
  filter(participant_1 != participant_2) %>%   # tira a diagonal (=1)
  # garantir combinações únicas
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(pair = paste(sort(c(participant_1, participant_2)), collapse = "_")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  distinct(pair, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  #Summarize
  summarize(
    comparison = "Human vs. Human",
    mean = mean(correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd   = sd(correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
    n    = sum(!is.na(correlation)),
    se   = sd / sqrt(n),
    tval = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
    ci_low  = mean - tval * se,
    ci_high = mean + tval * se
  ) 
  

# --- 3) Mouse vs Mouse ---
cor_mouse_mouse <- human_mouse_log2fc_samples %>%
  filter(organism == "Mouse") %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>%
  group_modify(~{
    df <- .x %>%
      select(participant_id, human_symbol, log2fc) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = participant_id, values_from = log2fc) %>%
      select(-human_symbol)
    
    # Calculate correlation
    cor_mat <- cor(df, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "pearson")
    
    # Long format
    cor_long <- as.data.frame(cor_mat) %>%
      rownames_to_column("participant_1") %>%
      melt(id.vars = "participant_1", variable.name = "participant_2", value.name = "correlation") %>%
      filter(participant_1 != participant_2) %>%
      rowwise() %>%
      mutate(pair = paste(sort(c(participant_1, participant_2)), collapse = "_")) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      distinct(pair, .keep_all = TRUE)
    
    # Summary
    tibble(
      comparison = "Mouse vs. Mouse",
      mean = mean(cor_long$correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd   = sd(cor_long$correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
      n    = nrow(cor_long),
      se   = sd / sqrt(n),
      tval = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
      ci_low  = mean - tval * se,
      ci_high = mean + tval * se
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup()


#Unite
correlation_long_all_mouse_human_timepoints_summary = cor_human_mouse_timepoint %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = timepoint_mouse) %>% 
  bind_rows(
    cor_human_human %>% mutate(timepoint = "24"),
    cor_mouse_mouse)

correlation_long_all_mouse_human_timepoints_summary
```

## BOOTSTRAP (ATUALIZAR)
```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# This script performs cross-species correlation (Human vs. Mouse)
# using the bootstrap method (1000 iterations), sampling 5 female participants
# from each organism in each iteration, as requested.

# --- 1. BOOTSTRAP CONFIGURATION ---
N_BOOTSTRAPS = 1000   # Number of bootstrap iterations
SAMPLE_SIZE = 5       # 5 humans vs 5 mice in each iteration

TIMEPOINTS = unique(human_mouse_log2fc_samples %>% filter(organism == "Mouse") %>% pull(timepoint)) %>% as.numeric()

# --- 2. DATA PREPARATION AND FILTERING (Female vs. Female) ---

#Get DEGs from either organisms


# Filters raw log2fc data only for the relevant timepoints
# and joins metadata to filter only 'Female' participants.
data_filtered <- human_mouse_log2fc_samples %>%
  filter(timepoint %in% TIMEPOINTS) 

human_data <- data_filtered %>% filter(organism == "Human")
mouse_data <- data_filtered %>% filter(organism == "Mouse")

# --- 3. FUNCTION FOR A SINGLE BOOTSTRAP ITERATION ---

# This function performs a single bootstrap iteration for a timepoint.
# 1. Samples 5 Human and 5 Mouse IDs (with replacement).
# 2. Filters data for sampled IDs and common symbols (genes).
# 3. Calculates the cross-correlation matrix (5x5).
# 4. Returns all 25 correlation values.
get_bootstrap_cors <- function(timepoint_val, all_human_data, all_mouse_data, n_sample) {

  # Filters data for the timepoint and identifies common symbols (genes)
  h_tp_data <- all_human_data %>% filter(timepoint == timepoint_val)
  m_tp_data <- all_mouse_data %>% filter(timepoint == timepoint_val)
  common_symbols <- intersect(h_tp_data$symbol, m_tp_data$symbol)

  # If there is no data or common symbols, returns an empty tibble
  if (length(unique(h_tp_data$participant_id)) < n_sample || 
      length(unique(m_tp_data$participant_id)) < n_sample ||
      length(common_symbols) == 0) {
    message(paste("Insufficient data for Timepoint:", timepoint_val))
    return(tibble(timepoint = timepoint_val, correlation = NA_real_))
  }

  # Samples N participant IDs (with replacement - bootstrap)
  sampled_human_pids <- sample(unique(h_tp_data$participant_id), n_sample, replace = TRUE)
  sampled_mouse_pids <- sample(unique(m_tp_data$participant_id), n_sample, replace = TRUE)

  # Prepares Human matrix (rows=symbols, columns=participants)
  h_matrix <- h_tp_data %>%
    filter(participant_id %in% sampled_human_pids, symbol %in% common_symbols) %>%
    # FIX: Ensure uniqueness of symbol/participant_id before pivoting to prevent 'duplicate row names' error
    distinct(symbol, participant_id, log2fc) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = participant_id, values_from = log2fc) %>%
    column_to_rownames("symbol")

  # Prepares Mouse matrix (rows=symbols, columns=participants)
  m_matrix <- m_tp_data %>%
    filter(participant_id %in% sampled_mouse_pids, symbol %in% common_symbols) %>%
    # FIX: Ensure uniqueness of symbol/participant_id before pivoting to prevent 'duplicate row names' error
    distinct(symbol, participant_id, log2fc) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = participant_id, values_from = log2fc) %>%
    column_to_rownames("symbol")

  # Ensures columns have unique names for correlation (necessary due to replace=TRUE)
  colnames(h_matrix) <- paste0("Human_", 1:ncol(h_matrix))
  colnames(m_matrix) <- paste0("Mouse_", 1:ncol(m_matrix))

  # Calculates the cross-correlation matrix (Spearman)
  cross_cors <- cor(h_matrix, m_matrix, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "pearson")

  # Extracts the N*N correlation values and adds the timepoint
  tibble(
    timepoint = timepoint_val,
    correlation = as.vector(cross_cors)
  )
}

# --- 4. BOOTSTRAP EXECUTION ---

# Creates a dataframe of bootstrap IDs and applies the function for all timepoints
bootstrapped_human_mouse_cors <- tibble(
    bootstrap_id = 1:N_BOOTSTRAPS
) %>%
rowwise() %>%
mutate(
    # Executes the bootstrap function for each timepoint 
    cors_data = list(
        bind_rows(
            get_bootstrap_cors(2, human_data, mouse_data, SAMPLE_SIZE),
            get_bootstrap_cors(6, human_data, mouse_data, SAMPLE_SIZE),
            get_bootstrap_cors(12, human_data, mouse_data, SAMPLE_SIZE),
            get_bootstrap_cors(24, human_data, mouse_data, SAMPLE_SIZE)
        ))) %>%
ungroup() %>%
unnest(cors_data)

# --- 5. BOOTSTRAP RESULTS SUMMARIZATION ---

# Calculates descriptive statistics on the distribution of correlations
# obtained by the 1000 bootstrap iterations (N_total = 1000 * 25 = 25000 observations)
correlation_bootstrap_summary <- bootstrapped_human_mouse_cors %>%
 group_by(timepoint) %>%
  summarize(
    comparison = "Bootstrap Mouse vs. Human",
    mean = mean(correlation, na.rm = T) %>% round(4),
    median = median(correlation, na.rm = T) %>% round(4),
    min = min(correlation, na.rm = T) %>% round(4),
    max = max(correlation, na.rm = T) %>% round(4),
    sd = sd(correlation, na.rm = T) %>% round(4),
    se = sd,
    ci_lower = quantile(correlation, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE) %>% round(4),
    ci_upper = quantile(correlation, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE) %>% round(4),
    .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = as.character(timepoint),
         unit = "Day")
```

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=7}
#Sample 5 participants

#Create table
ggpairs_data_dge_btm_mean_process = dge_btm_mean_process

  colnames()


plot_data <-
  #Pivot longer, 1st participatn
  ggpairs_data_dge_btm_mean_process %>%
  select(group, process, sample_participants_5) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = !c("group", "process"), 
               names_to = "participant_1", 
               values_to = "participant_1_value") %>%
  
  #Add a column to the 2nd participant
  inner_join(
    ggpairs_data_dge_btm_mean_process %>%
      select(group, process, sample_participants_5) %>%
      pivot_longer(cols = !c("group", "process"), 
                   names_to = "participant_2",
                   values_to = "participant_2_value"),
    by = c("process", "group")) %>%
  #Remove pares idênticos (mesma variável)
  filter(participant_1 != participant_2) %>%
  
  #Remove dupes (ex: A-B e B-A → A-B)
  mutate(pair_min = pmin(participant_1, participant_2),
         pair_max = pmax(participant_1, participant_2)) %>%
  distinct(process, pair_min, pair_max, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% 
  
  # Arrange participants to create a pairwise matrix
  mutate(
    participant_1 = factor(participant_1, levels = sample_participants_5),
    participant_2 = factor(participant_2, levels = rev(sample_participants_5)))
```

```{r}
#Import datasets ------
#Import DGE output
all_degs_human_mouse = readRDS(here("tables", "saureus_infection_human_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds")) %>% 
  mutate(pathogen = "Saureus")
#Import BTMs annotation table
btm_annotation_genes = read_csv(file = here("tables", "btm_annotation_genes.csv"))

filename = "saureus_infection_human_mouse"

#Clean metadata 
annotation_conditions = all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
  select(condition, timepoint, model = organism) %>% 
  distinct() 

# Gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA) --------
#Get calculate means -----
#Annotate genes by BTM 

dge_btm_process_genes = all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
  rename(symbol = human_symbol) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  inner_join(btm_annotation_genes, by = "symbol") %>% 
  filter(immune_set == "BTM by Modules") %>%
  filter(organism %in% c("Human", "Mouse")) 

dge_btm_process_genes %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_dge_btm_process_genes.rds")))

dge_btm_mean_process = dge_btm_process_genes %>% 
  group_by(organism, timepoint, process) %>% 
  summarize(mean_log2fc = mean(mean_l2fc),
            median_log2fc = median(mean_l2fc),
            sd_log2fc = sd(mean_l2fc),
            var_log2fc = var(mean_l2fc),
            n_genes = n(),
            organism, pathogen,
            group, subgroup) %>%
  distinct() %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(condition = paste0(organism,"_", pathogen, "_", timepoint)) 

#Print
dge_btm_mean_process %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_dge_btm_mean_process.rds")))
```

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
   mutate(condition = paste0(organism,"_", pathogen, "_", timepoint)) %>% 
  select(condition, genes, log2fold_change)


#Run multiple GSEA and unite means

  as.data.frame() %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  rename(process = id) %>%
  #Unite means and GSEA
```

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=7}
#Calculate correlation -----

# Means vs means
cor_labels <- dge_btm_process_genes_wide %>%
  select(process, timepoint, group, Mouse = mean_l2fc_Mouse, Human = mean_l2fc_Human) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  summarise(test_result = list(cor.test(x = Human, 
                                        y = Mouse, 
                                        use = "pairwise.complete.obs", 
                                        method = "pearson")), 
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(cor_value = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "estimate"),
         p_value = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "p.value")) %>%
  select(-test_result) %>%
  # Labels
  mutate(r_squared = cor_value^2,
    p_label = ifelse(p_value < 0.01,
                     "p = <0.01",
                     paste0("p = ", round(p_value, 2))),
    cor_label = paste0(
      "r = ", round(cor_value, 2),
      ", R² = ", round(r_squared, 2),
      ", ", p_label)) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint_num = readr::parse_number(timepoint),
    timepoint = paste0(timepoint, "h"),
    timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = unique(timepoint[order(timepoint_num)]))) 

# NES vs NES
cor_labels_nes <- dge_btm_gsea_mean_wide %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(process, timepoint, group, subgroup, Mouse = nes_Mouse, Human = nes_Human) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  summarise(test_result = list(cor.test(x = Human, 
                                        y = Mouse, 
                                        use = "pairwise.complete.obs", 
                                        method = "pearson")), 
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(cor_value = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "estimate"),
         p_value = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "p.value")) %>%
  select(-test_result) %>%
  # Labels
  mutate(r_squared = cor_value^2,
    p_label = ifelse(p_value < 0.01,
                     "p = <0.01",
                     paste0("p = ", round(p_value, 2))),
    cor_label = paste0(
      "r = ", round(cor_value, 2),
      ", R² = ", round(r_squared, 2),
      ", ", p_label)) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint_num = readr::parse_number(timepoint),
    timepoint = paste0(timepoint, "h"),
    timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = unique(timepoint[order(timepoint_num)])))
```

```{r}
#Import BTMs annotation table
btm_annotation_genes = read_csv(file = here("tables", "btm_annotation_genes.csv"))

               select(process, group, subgroup) %>% 
               distinct(),
             by = "process") %>% 
  ungroup()
```
