#### Summarize inter-individual correlation

##### 1 individual vs 1 individual

```{r}
# --- 1) Mouse vs Human no mesmo timepoint ---
#Get timepoints
timepoints_human <- unique(dge_btm_mean_process_sample_long %>% filter(organism == "Human") %>% pull(timepoint))
timepoints_mouse <- unique(dge_btm_mean_process_sample_long %>% filter(organism == "Mouse") %>% pull(timepoint))

#Get combinations
timepoint_combinations <- expand.grid(timepoint_human = timepoints_human,
                                      timepoint_mouse = timepoints_mouse,
                                      stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Loop
cor_human_mouse_timepoint <- timepoint_combinations %>%
  pmap_dfr(function(timepoint_human, timepoint_mouse) {
    
    # pegar os participantes do timepoint específico
    human_df <- dge_btm_mean_process_sample_long %>%
      filter(organism == "Human", timepoint == timepoint_human) %>%
      select(participant_id, process, mean_log2fc)
    
    mouse_df <- dge_btm_mean_process_sample_long %>%
      filter(organism == "Mouse", timepoint == timepoint_mouse) %>%
      select(participant_id, process, mean_log2fc)
    
    # manter apenas genes em comum
    common_process <- intersect(human_df$process, mouse_df$process)
    human_df <- human_df %>% filter(process %in% common_process)
    mouse_df <- mouse_df %>% filter(process %in% common_process)
    
    # pivot para wide
    human_wide <- human_df %>% pivot_wider(names_from = participant_id, values_from = mean_log2fc)
    mouse_wide <- mouse_df %>% pivot_wider(names_from = participant_id, values_from = mean_log2fc)
    
    # IDs de participantes
    human_ids <- setdiff(colnames(human_wide), "process")
    mouse_ids <- setdiff(colnames(mouse_wide), "process")
    
    # calcular correlação para todos pares humano x mouse
    expand.grid(human = human_ids, mouse = mouse_ids, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
      mutate(
        cor_test = map2(human, mouse, ~{
          x <- human_wide[[.x]]
          y <- mouse_wide[[.y]]
          # remover NAs correspondentes
          keep <- complete.cases(x, y)
          cor.test(x[keep], y[keep], method = "pearson")
        }),
        r       = map_dbl(cor_test, ~.x$estimate),
        p_value = map_dbl(cor_test, ~.x$p.value),
        ci_low  = map_dbl(cor_test, ~.x$conf.int[1]),
        ci_high = map_dbl(cor_test, ~.x$conf.int[2])
      ) %>%
      select(-cor_test) %>%
      mutate(timepoint_human = timepoint_human %>% as.numeric(),
             timepoint_mouse = timepoint_mouse %>% as.numeric())
  }) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint_human, timepoint_mouse) %>%
  summarize(
    comparison = "Human vs. Mouse",
    mean = mean(r, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd   = sd(r, na.rm = TRUE),
    n      = sum(!is.na(r)),
    se     = sd / sqrt(n),
    tval   = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
    ci_low = mean - tval * se,
    ci_high = mean + tval * se,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cor_human_mouse_timepoint

# --- 2) Human vs Human (entre timepoints) ---
cor_human_human <- dge_btm_mean_process_sample_long %>%
  mutate(timepoint = as.numeric(timepoint)) %>% 
  filter(organism == "Human") %>%
  select(participant_id, process, timepoint, mean_log2fc) %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = participant_id,
    values_from = mean_log2fc
  ) %>%
  select(-process, -timepoint) %>%   # só colunas de participantes
  cor(use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "pearson") %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("participant_1") %>%
  melt(id.vars = "participant_1", variable.name = "participant_2", value.name = "correlation") %>% 
  filter(participant_1 != participant_2) %>%   # tira a diagonal (=1)
  # garantir combinações únicas
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(pair = paste(sort(c(participant_1, participant_2)), collapse = "_")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  distinct(pair, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  #Summarize
  summarize(
    comparison = "Human vs. Human",
    mean = mean(correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd   = sd(correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
    n    = sum(!is.na(correlation)),
    se   = sd / sqrt(n),
    tval = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
    ci_low  = mean - tval * se,
    ci_high = mean + tval * se
  ) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = 24,
         timepoint_human = timepoint)
  

# --- 3) Mouse vs Mouse ---
cor_mouse_mouse <- dge_btm_mean_process_sample_long %>%
  filter(organism == "Mouse") %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>%
  group_modify(~{
    df <- .x %>%
      select(participant_id, process, mean_log2fc) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = participant_id, values_from = mean_log2fc) %>%
      select(-process)
    
    # Calculate correlation
    cor_mat <- cor(df, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "pearson")
    
    # Long format
    cor_long <- as.data.frame(cor_mat) %>%
      rownames_to_column("participant_1") %>%
      melt(id.vars = "participant_1", variable.name = "participant_2", value.name = "correlation") %>%
      filter(participant_1 != participant_2) %>%
      rowwise() %>%
      mutate(pair = paste(sort(c(participant_1, participant_2)), collapse = "_")) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      distinct(pair, .keep_all = TRUE)
    
    # Summary
    tibble(
      comparison = "Mouse vs. Mouse",
      mean = mean(cor_long$correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd   = sd(cor_long$correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
      n    = nrow(cor_long),
      se   = sd / sqrt(n),
      tval = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
      ci_low  = mean - tval * se,
      ci_high = mean + tval * se
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = as.numeric(timepoint), 
         timepoint_mouse = timepoint)


#Unite
correlation_long_all_btm_mouse_human_timepoints_summary = cor_human_mouse_timepoint %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = timepoint_mouse) %>% 
  bind_rows(
    cor_human_human,
    cor_mouse_mouse)

#Print
correlation_long_all_btm_mouse_human_timepoints_summary

correlation_long_all_btm_mouse_human_timepoints_summary %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_samples_btm_correlation_all_timepoints_summary.rds")))
```

# 4. E. coli
## Get overlap

Input

```{r}
# Import datasets
dge_long_genes = read_rds(file = here("tables", "ecoli_infection_human_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds"))
btm_annotation_genes = read_csv(file = here("tables", "btm_annotation_genes.csv"))

# DEGs table
degs_all_updown = dge_long_genes %>% 
  dplyr::filter(organism %in% c("Human", "Mouse")) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(adj_p_val <= 0.05) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(condition = paste0(organism, "_", timepoint)) %>% 
  dplyr::select(process = condition, genes = human_symbol)

# Metadata
annotation_metadata = dge_long_genes %>% 
  #Arrange columns in the desired order to be displayed on the heatmap
  dplyr::select(condition, 
                organism, 
                # type, 
                # vaccine, 
                timepoint) %>% 
  mutate(condition = paste0(organism, "_", timepoint))

annotation_metadata$condition %>% unique()
#Inputs
filename = "ecoli_infection"
```

Perform calculations

```{r}
conflicted::conflicts_prefer(base::intersect)
conflicted::conflicts_prefer(base::setdiff)

# Perform calculations
unique_cond <- unique(degs_all_updown$process) # List sets
shared_genes_df <- data.frame() # Store data

for (i in 1:(length(unique_cond) - 1)) {
  for (j in (i + 1):length(unique_cond)) {
    results_temp <- overlap_genes(unique_cond[i], unique_cond[j], degs_all_updown)
    shared_genes_df <- bind_rows(shared_genes_df, results_temp)
  }
}

# Fisher's exact test
fisher_exact_test <- function(shared, notshared1, notshared2) {
  cont_table <- matrix(c(shared, notshared1, notshared2, 0), nrow = 2)
  results_fisher <- stats::fisher.test(cont_table)
  return(results_fisher$p.value)
}
shared_genes_df = shared_genes_df %>%
  mutate(pvalue = pmap_dbl(list(Shared, NotShared_cond1, NotShared_cond2), fisher_exact_test),
         p_adj = p.adjust(pvalue))


#Mirror table
shared_genes_df2 = shared_genes_df %>% 
  dplyr::rename(Cond1_temp = Cond1, Cond2_temp = Cond2) %>%
  dplyr::rename(Cond1 = Cond2_temp, Cond2 = Cond1_temp)

shared_genes_df_mirror = shared_genes_df %>% 
  dplyr::bind_rows(shared_genes_df2) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(Percentage_Shared_Cond1 = round(Percentage_Shared_Cond1, 2),
         Percentage_Shared_Cond2 = round(Percentage_Shared_Cond2, 2))
  
#Jaccard distance
jaccard.matrix <- degs_all_updown %>%
  dplyr::mutate(present = 1) %>% 
  dplyr::distinct() %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = genes, values_from = present, values_fill = 0) %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "process") %>%
  vegan::vegdist(binary = TRUE, method = "jaccard", diag = TRUE, upper = TRUE) %>%
  as.matrix() %>%
  {1 - .}
shared_genes_df_mirror = jaccard.matrix %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("Cond1") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -"Cond1",
               names_to = "Cond2",
               values_to = "jaccard_distance") %>% 
  inner_join(shared_genes_df_mirror, by = join_by(Cond1, Cond2)) %>% 
  mutate(jaccard_distance = round(jaccard_distance, 3))

#Save
write_csv(shared_genes_df_mirror, 
          file = here("Tables", paste0(filename, "_sharedgenes_Fisher_Jaccard.csv")))
shared_genes_df_mirror
```

```{r}
shared_genes_df_mirror = read_csv(file = here("Tables", "ecoli_infection_sharedgenes_Fisher_Jaccard.csv"))

  column_to_rownames("Cond1") %>%
  mutate_if(is.character, as.numeric) %>% 
  as.matrix() 

# Create a matrix of p-values
pvalue_matrix <- shared_genes_df_mirror %>%
  dcast(Cond1 ~ Cond2,
        value.var = "p_adj",
        fun.aggregate = mean) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Cond1") %>%
  as.matrix()

dim(matrix_data)

# merge

  colnames() %>%

# Reorder
matrix_data_ordered = matrix_data %>%

  if (!is.na(mat[i, j]) && mat[i, j] > 0) {
    grid.text(sprintf("%.f", mat[i, j]), x, y, gp = gpar(fontsize = 8, color = "white"))
  }
                           i# Add significance stars based on p-value thresholds
  if (!is.na(pvalue_matrix[i, j])) {
    pval <- pvalue_matrix[i, j]
    sig <- ""
    if (pval < 0.01) {
      sig <- "***"
    } else if (pval < 0.05) {
      sig <- "**"
    } else if (pval < 0.10) {
      sig <- "*"
    }

    }
  }
},
```

### Stacked barplot of overlapped genes
```{r fig.width=10, fig.height=4}
#Import datasets
all_degs_human_mouse = readRDS(here("tables", "ecoli_infection_human_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds"))  
ImmuneGO_Mouse_Manual_genes <- read_excel(here("VaxGO", "ImmuneGO_Mouse.xlsx")) %>% 
  separate_rows(genes)


#Compare every mouse timepoint to a human reference
timepoint_reference = "24"
human_data_reference <- all_degs_human_mouse %>% filter(organism == "Human")
new_timepoints <- c(all_degs_human_mouse %>% filter(organism != "Human") %>% pull(timepoint) %>% unique() %>% as.character())
duplicated_human_data <- map_dfr(new_timepoints, ~ {
  df_copy <- human_data_reference
  df_copy <- df_copy %>%
    mutate(timepoint = .x)

  return(df_copy)
})

dge_long_genes_matched = all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(organism != "Human") %>% 
  bind_rows(duplicated_human_data)  %>% 
    mutate(timepoint_num = readr::parse_number(timepoint),
    timepoint = paste0(timepoint, "h"),
    timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = unique(timepoint[order(timepoint_num)]))) 


#Get total genes by each condition
degs_mouse = dge_long_genes_matched %>% 
  filter(adj_p_val <= 0.05,
         organism == "Mouse")
degs_human = dge_long_genes_matched %>% 
  filter(adj_p_val <= 0.05,
         organism == "Human")

degs_mouse_summarize = dge_long_genes_matched %>% 
  filter(adj_p_val <= 0.05) %>% 
  group_by(organism, timepoint) %>% 
  summarize(n_genes = n()) 

#Print
degs_mouse_summarize

#Get overlap -----
#Get symbols
degs_mouse_genes = degs_mouse %>% 
  select(human_symbol, timepoint) %>% 
  distinct()

degs_human_genes = degs_human %>% 
  select(human_symbol, timepoint) %>% 
  distinct()

#Inner join, Mouse and Human ------

#Mouse
degs_human_and_mouse_genes = degs_human_genes %>% 
  inner_join(degs_mouse_genes, 
             by = join_by("human_symbol", "timepoint")) %>% 
  mutate(condition = "Mouse AND Human",
         comparison = "Mouse vs Human",
         organism = "Mouse",
         group = "Common")

#Duplicate rows for human
degs_human_and_mouse_genes_human = degs_human_and_mouse_genes %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Human")


#Anti join, Human vs Mouse -------
#Human
#Human vs Mouse
degs_human_Not_mouse_genes = degs_human_genes %>% 
  anti_join(degs_mouse_genes, 
             by = join_by("human_symbol", "timepoint")) %>% 
  mutate(condition = "Human NOT Mouse", 
         comparison = "Mouse vs Human",
         organism = "Human",
         group = "Not common")

#Models
#Mouse vs Human
degs_mouse_Not_human_genes = degs_mouse_genes %>% 
  anti_join(degs_human_genes, 
             by = join_by("human_symbol", "timepoint")) %>% 
  mutate(condition = "Mouse NOT Human",
         organism = "Mouse",
         comparison = "Mouse vs Human",
         group = "Not common")


#Merge data ------
degs_human_mouse_overlap_genes = 
  bind_rows(degs_human_and_mouse_genes,
            degs_human_and_mouse_genes_human,
            degs_human_Not_mouse_genes,
            degs_mouse_Not_human_genes 
            )

#Classify by same and exclusive DEGs -----
degs_human_mouse_overlap_genes_summary = degs_human_mouse_overlap_genes %>% 
  group_by(condition, timepoint) %>% 
  summarize(n = n(),
            organism,
            comparison,
            group) %>% 
  distinct()

#Print
degs_human_mouse_overlap_genes_summary
```
